column1:
『超古代の言語形態１』
<pause>
超古代文明時代にはニつの言語が
発達していたと言われている。
<pause>
一つは上位古代語と呼ばれる言語
だが、起源は一万年前とも十万年
前とも言われている古い言語であ
る。
<pause>
もう一つはコモン語と呼ばれる言
語である。
<pause>
我々の話す言葉などはこの言語が
元であると言われている。
<pause>
また、このニつの言語を法印状に
組み合わせた文章が刻まれている
石盤も多数発見されている。{END}
column2:
“Forms of Ancient Language 1”
<pause>
Archaeologists generally agree that
two primary languages developed
during the Age of Antiquity.
<pause>
They have designated one of them
as the “Higher Language,” which
likely first came into use between
ten and a hundred millennia ago.
<pause>
The other has been called the
“Common Language,” which is
thought to be the source of modern
languages.
<pause>
The numerous stone slabs
discovered engraved with scripture
composed in both languages strongly
supports this theory.{END}

column1:
『禁呪文』
<pause>
この世界に存在する魔術の中には、
<pause>
いにしえに封印された禁呪文と呼
ばれるものがある。
<pause>
その一つとして自己犠牲魔術があ
る。
<pause>
自らの全精力を熱エネルギーに変
換、全魔力を使ってそれを圧縮、
爆発させるという。
<pause>
不思議なことに魔術をかける直前
自然と自分の周囲に結界が張られ
て爆発の範囲を抑えるという。
<pause>
攻撃力を上げるためか、周囲に爆
発の影響を与えないためかは定か
ではない。{END}
column2:
“Forbidden Spells”
<pause>
Of the magic spells of this world,
there exist so-called “Forbidden
Spells” which have been sealed
away.
<pause>
Among these spells is one which
calls for the sacrifice of the caster.
<pause>
This is conducted by converting
all of the caster's willpower into
thermal energy as well as their
magic power into pressure,
resulting in a powerful spontaneous
combustion of sorts.
<pause>
Just before the spell activates, a
barrier envelops the area around
the body, limiting the range of the
explosion. It is not certain why this
occurs.
<pause>
A theory gaining prominence is that
the limited range naturally packs
the combustive energy more
densely, allowing the explosion to be
smaller yet more destructive.{END}

column1:
『癒しの術』
<pause>
魔術は主に攻撃を主体とするもの
が多いが、それとは別に癒しの効
果を持つ奇跡の力があるという。
<pause>
魔術は自らの魔力を使うが、癒し
の力は、大地や神の助力によって
成り立つと言われている。
<pause>
しかし、いまだ存在は確認されて
いない。{END}
column2:
“Healing Artes”
<pause>
Destruction is the chief property of
magic, but there also exists a
miraculous power of restoration.
<pause>
It is known that there are different
factors in one's ability to command
these two powers, but current
research is incomplete.
<pause>
Destructive spells are the simple
result of a caster's innate magical
ability, but those of the restorative
class are thought to be a gift from
the Mother Goddess.
<pause>
However, the truth behind the
ability to use restorative spells is
still shrouded in much mystery, as
the existence of the Goddess herself
is yet to be proven.{END}

column1:
『月と星』
<pause>
我々がいつも見ている月、大きい
方がシルヴァラント、小さい方が
テセアラと呼ばれています。
<pause>
これらニつの月は我々の住んでい
るこの星の衛星です。
<pause>
シルヴァラントは約３５日、テセ
アラは約４２日でこの星を一周し
ます。
<pause>
このニつの月の間には、お互いの
引力による影響で隕石が無数に浮
遊して存在しています。
<pause>
しかし残念ながら望遠鏡などを用
いなければ、これらを見ることは
できません。{END}
column2:
“Our Planet-Moon System”
<pause>
The moons visible to the naked eye
are called Sylvarant and Tethe'alla.
Sylvarant is the larger of the two,
and Tethe'alla the smaller one.
<pause>
These two moons orbit around the
planet on which we live.
<pause>
Sylvarant's orbital period is
approximately 35 days, while
Tethe'alla's is approximately 42.
<pause>
Quite astoundingly, a countless
number of asteroids are suspended
between the two moons, affected
by the moons' mutual gravitational
forces.
<pause>
Unfortunately, these objects are too
minuscule to be seen with
an unaided eye--telescopes are
necessary to observe them.{END}

column1:
『超古代都市トールについて』
<pause>
トールの文化が最盛期にあったこ
ろ、その存在は他のいかなる国よ
りも大きなものでした。
<pause>
はるかに高度な科学技術を有し、
それを国の基盤としていました。
<pause>
しかし、極めて閉鎖的に発展して
きたとも言われています。
<pause>
トールに住んでいた人々に、その
高度な技術を育てた一因がありま
す。
<pause>
人種的にもたぐいまれな能力を有
する種族だったようです。{END}
column2:
“About the Ancient City of Thor”
<pause>
During its golden age, the civilization
of Thor was comprised of an
enormous nation, the likes of which
have still not been seen.
<pause>
The bedrock of this nation was its
incredibly advanced science and
technology.
<pause>
However, the country later
developed extremely insular and
xenophobic tendencies.
<pause>
This is thought to have been
because of the technology Thor's
population grew up with.
<pause>
Likely due to prolonged exposure to
their technology, the country's
people seem to have possessed
some very unique racial
characteristics.{END}

column1:

<pause>
『ドラム』という打楽器でリズム

<pause>

column2:

<pause>
Unlike today, extremely high tempo
music was in fashion in ancient
civilizations.
<pause>
“Electric guitars,” guitars using

rhythm of percussion instruments

<pause>
“Bass”--a low-frequency
sound--was produced by
instruments such as the “double
bass.”
<pause>
One of the most intriguing
instruments was the “keyboard,” a
sort of electric piano used in
performances.{END}

<pause>

<pause>
<audio_11F7>ルーングロム

<pause>

<pause>
<audio_11FE>国王
「おぬしらの話は伝説となって我

<pause>
<audio_11FF>国王
「今から１５０年前、世界の敵と
　なっていたダオスを倒したと」
<pause>
<audio_1200>国王
「万策尽きた我々にはもうおぬし
　らしか頼るものがない」
<pause>
<audio_1201>国王
「吉報を待っておりますぞ」{END}
column2:
<audio_11EB>King:<nl>
 I believe you have already heard
 this from Harrison, but Dhaos now
 threatens the entire world.
<pause>
<audio_11EC>King:<nl>
 He also possesses the power to
 travel further into the future at
 will.
<pause>
<audio_11ED>King:<nl>
 It is quite evident that he will use
 it to go further in time whenever
 threatened, to repeat his cycle of
 terror forevermore.
<pause>
<audio_11EE>King:<nl>
 Something must be done about it.
 We cannot allow this fruitless
 struggle to continue any longer.
<pause>
<audio_11EF><Klarth>:<nl>
 Absolutely.
 Do you have any ideas or leads?
<pause>
<audio_11F0>Lundgrom:<nl>
 We've retrieved information from
 an ancient relic discovered at Thor.
 It might be the death knell
 of this vicious cycle.
<pause>
<audio_11F1><Cless>:<nl>
 What's it about?
<pause>
<audio_11F2>Lundgrom:<nl>
 Millennia ago, during the so-called
 Age of Antiquity, the three worldly
 superpowers fought for authority
 over the planet's mainland.
<pause>
<audio_11F3>Lundgrom:<nl>
 I'm sure you've heard this much at
 least, but those superpowers were
 known as Odin, Fenrir, and Thor.
<pause>
<audio_11F4>Lundgrom:<nl>
 One fateful day, an asteroid struck
 Thor, plunging it into the depths of
 the sea.
<pause>
<audio_11F5>Lundgrom:<nl>
 Afterward, mysterious men arose
 and put an end to the then
 deadlocked war by destroying the
 two remaining nations.
<pause>
<audio_11F6>Lundgrom:<nl>
 The men employed a triad of
 armaments, collectively known as
 the Tria.
<pause>
<audio_11F7>Lundgrom:<nl>
 Records about them were included
 in the documents we uncovered.
<pause>
<audio_11F8><Klarth>:<nl>
 Grab hold of these things,
 and we give Dhaos a taste
 of ancient destruction?
 Hmhm... I like it.
<pause>
<audio_11F9>Lundgrom:<nl>
 Our study of the records revealed
 that the fusion of them would
 result in a magic sword capable of
 manipulating time.
<pause>
<audio_11FA><Klarth>:<nl>
 Something like that should allow us
 to shackle him to this time period.
<pause>
<audio_11FB>Lundgrom:<nl>
 Helpful, isn't it?
<pause>
<audio_11FC>Lundgrom:<nl>
 Anyway, the people in the <color_0002>Magic
 Research Lab<color_0000> can tell you more.
<pause>
<audio_11FD>King:<nl>
 To think young ones such as
 yourselves were able to defeat
 Dhaos...
<pause>
<audio_11FE>King:<nl>
 Your story--the tale that you
 defeated Dhaos, the sworn enemy
 of the world a hundred fifty years
 ago...
<pause>
<audio_11FF>King:<nl>
 ...has become legend throughout my
 kingdom.
<pause>
<audio_1200>King:<nl>
 But once again, it seems all we
 have left is to depend upon you.
<pause>
<audio_1201>King:<nl>
 I shall await fortuitous news.{END}

column1:

<pause>

<pause>

<pause>

 highly unusual, but nothing more.
<pause>
<audio_1207>Lundgrom:<nl>

 by a constant darkness?{END}

column1:

<pause>
<audio_1209>ルーングロム

　そこに<color_0002>アーリィ<color_0000>という町がある」
<pause>
<audio_120A>ルーングロム
「ダオスは時間を操る力があるん
　だろう」
<pause>
<audio_120B>ルーングロム
「行ってみれば何か手がかりがつ
　かめるかもしれないな」
<pause>

<pause>
<audio_120D>ルーングロム

column2:
<audio_1208>Lundgrom:<nl>

 place.
<pause>
<audio_1209>Lundgrom:<nl>
 I know little about the area, but a
 town called <color_0002>Early<color_0000> stands there.
<pause>
<audio_120A>Lundgrom:<nl>
 Considering that Dhaos has the
 power to control time...
<pause>
<audio_120B>Lundgrom:<nl>
 I would not be surprised if he has
 a hand in the situation there.
<pause>
<audio_120C><Klarth>:<nl>
 Definitely suspicious. I can't tell if
 that guy's going easy on us or
 what. The darkness thing sounds
 like a dead giveaway, honestly.
<pause>
<audio_120D>Lundgrom:<nl>
 Agreed. Perhaps he positioned his
 fortress in such a remote region in
 an attempt to avoid arousing
 suspicion or to buy time.{END}
